number.description: The pull request's or issue's number on the forge (GitHub's and Forgejo's number, GitLab's `iid`, Azure DevOps' pull request or work item id). Tangled has no numbers: use `id`.

id.description: The forge's own id of the item, as a string: the number again on GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Forgejo and Gitea; the record's AT-URI (`at://did:.../sh.tangled.repo.pull/<rkey>`) on Tangled.

type.description: Azure DevOps: the work item type (Bug, Task, User Story, Product Backlog Item, Issue, as the project's process names them).

author.description: A user's login (user name) on the forge; on Tangled their handle, else their DID.

items.description: A user's login (user name) on the forge; on Tangled their handle, else their DID.
A label's name (a tag on Azure DevOps).
